ഈയട്ൂബ് ചാനൽ ഇതുവരെ സബ്സ്ക്രൈബ്
ചെയ്തിട്ടില്ലെങ്കിൽ ഇപ്പോൾ ഇപ്പോൾ തന്നെ
സബ്സ്ക്രൈബ് ചെയ്യുക.
[സംഗീതം]
english:
Thank you Lord, thank you Jesus Christ, thank you Mother of Kreupasanam, for blessing me to come here today and to stand on this holy ground to share my testimony. I especially
want to thank you. I am Dr. Gracy. I have been working in Abu Dhabi for 34 years; we have our own medical centre. My husband is Dr. Joseph. On January 12th,
on the 11th, there was a get-together of my school’s tenth standard batch. I had come for that event. After it ended, I went to my home in Kodanchery.
In Kodanchery, since I was a child — from when I was about three years old — I have always been praying rosary knelt down to Mother. Whenever I go there, I make sure to visit the Mother of Kodanchery,
sit near her and share a few words before returning. This time too, I went, parked my car, went to Mother’s side, spoke a few words, and on returning, I saw that my car — a blue car —
was completely covered with elengi flowers. Then I remembered something my mother used to say when I was a child: “The scent of elengi is the fragrance of Mother.” Perhaps today’s
generation doesn’t know that scent anymore. At that moment, I felt an overwhelming joy. I thought, “Mother has appeared near me… the Mother of Kodanchery has come!” After that, I went home,
had breakfast, and drove myself back to my flat. I collected all those elengi flowers carefully in a tissue and kept them inside my car. Since then, whenever I drive,
I keep reciting the rosary — whether I’m in Abu Dhabi or anywhere else, I do the same. As I was driving and praying, after a while, this Mother appeared before me.
Usually, when I do any work at home after duty, I listen to spiritual talks on YouTube — either by Fr. Joseph or by Fr. Daniel.
So, usually, I don’t see Mother because I keep my phone somewhere nearby while working — I just listen. But that day, when Mother appeared, I felt, “Oh! What is this feeling?”
I was actually driving my car at that time, and I thought, “Maybe it’s just my imagination.” So I continued praying the rosary and driving — about 35 kilometers
on the way to my flat. While driving along that road, once again, the same Mother appeared before me. Then I wondered, “Am I feeling sleepy?”
Anyway, after driving a bit further, I saw a coconut vendor by the roadside. I stopped there, bought a coconut, drank the water, and continued driving while praying the rosary. Then again,
Mother appeared before me. She came right in front of me! I was utterly amazed. Later, when I reached home, I lay down to rest. After about an hour, my sister’s daughter came and rang the bell.
When I opened the door and spoke to her, we ended up talking about Kreupasanam Mother. That astonished me even more! At that time, there was no other doctor around — only me.
Then I called one of my cousins and told her about my experience with Mother. She told me that she was planning to go to Kreupasanam within two weeks to take the covenant, and she invited me to come along.
I was overjoyed because I had another meeting scheduled in two days, after which the doctor from Abu Dhabi was supposed to return. Around that time, since recovering from COVID,
I had developed mild arthritis in my hands. So I decided firmly that I would book the trip. It was close to my birthday — January 13th —
but I cancelled all my other plans and came along with them to Kreupasanam. We reached here early in the morning on January 14th. I ran joyfully to Mother that morning, I saw the mass was going here.
I was walking then, and when I looked up — it was the same Mother! The very same Mother I had seen in my car earlier. I was astonished beyond words. I took the covenant that day,
and by the time I reached home that night, it was about 1 o’clock. While sitting in the car, I didn’t pick up my phone because bright light gives me headaches. So what I did was, after reaching home, before going to bed,
I called my husband and told him, “Tomorrow I’m going to Kreupasanam.” He asked, “Why suddenly?  why Kreupasanam now?”
I told him about the experience I had. Then he said, “If that’s true, then please also pray for a few of my intentions.”
So he will talk about it. I came here and wrote down all of that in the covenant — especially that my son should grow stronger in faith. That’s what I always pray for.
After writing that, when I reached home and took my phone, I saw a message from his sister's son’s wife. It was Sunday, and during Holy Mass, at the very same time when I had seen Mother,
she too had seen a vision — she saw me, Fr. Joseph, and the Mother of Kreupasanam throughout the entire Mass! Then she had messaged me, saying,
“Aunty, aunty, when you will return to India..” She didn’t know that I had come home, because I had told no one — it was just a short visit for a small meeting. She said "When you will return home, please see Mother of Kreupasanam"
So when she said that, I was completely amazed. I told Shaji, “This is such an extraordinary coincidence — I’ve just arrived here and she’s saying she saw us there!” After that, the very next day,
I returned to Abu Dhabi. The meeting was scheduled in Shoranur, and after that day, from then onward, Mother started intervening in the matter Dr. Joseph had asked me to pray for. That part, the doctor will tell you.
Due to time limits, I’ll just say that afterward, I went back to Abu Dhabi. One evening, I was driving home from my medical centre — that’s what I’m going to tell you now.
I saw this in a dream. In that dream, while I was driving, there was someone sitting in the front seat and another person sitting in the back seat. After a while, the one sitting behind said,
“I want to get down.” So I quickly stopped the car and turned around to see who it was. And there she was — Mother Mary, dressed in a turquoise blue, shining brightly! I immediately said,
“Oh! Was it Mother?” I sat there, astonished, and then felt immense joy. Later I fell asleep again, and when I woke up, I was filled with peace. Then I realized — if Mother came in the car,
it must mean she is moving with me in all my affairs, including my business matters — which the doctor will explain. So I understood that Mother was traveling with me,
and everything was being made ready. Then I asked Mother, “Mother, why haven’t you come to my house yet? Is there some problem at home — is that why You haven’t come?” That night, when I went to sleep again,
Mother appeared before me. Suddenly, I was filled with immense joy. I jumped up from bed, thinking, “Mother has come home!” I ran downstairs — I sleep upstairs —
and when I looked, I saw the very same Mother who had appeared before me earlier. Two years ago, when a doctor named Madhavan had visited my home, he had given me a statue, saying,
“This is a powerful image of Mother. The Mother of Kreupasanam” I hadn’t known then that it was the Mother of Kreupasanam. When I looked now, I realized — it was the same Mother, standing at the centre of my dining table!
I hadn’t known this was the Kreupasanam Mother until then. It was such a miracle. Then I asked, “Mother, who was sitting with You in the car earlier?” And in my heart, I heard the reply:
“Who else would be with Me, but My Son.” That filled me with even greater awe. Since then, so many miracles have happened. The vision had appeared on the 14th of January,
and after that, on every 14th day of the following months, new miracles happened — all the intentions I had written in the covenant were fulfilled, and even one great miracle that I hadn’t written down took place on September 14th.
I will let the doctor continue from here, due to lack of time. It was a Sunday — after finishing my duty, I was on my way to church. You know how wide the roads are in Abu Dhabi. I was driving toward a junction…
As I was coming down the flyover, the car was moving slowly when suddenly I heard a loud sound. I looked and saw that a delivery man had fallen onto the road after being hit. I immediately turned on the hazard lights,
ran out, and saw him lying there, after having an heart attack — his body was stiff, completely lifeless. I knelt down on the road and prayed, “My Jesus, take my life; Mother of Kreupasanam, take my life and give it to him.”
Then I started giving cardiac massage. I did it continuously for about five compressions — there was no response. On the sixth compression,
he suddenly moved his head slightly. I understood then — Mother had intervened and given him life! It was an incredible miracle.
Even after that, though there was still no heartbeat, he was beginning to show small movements. I continued CPR, and by that time, the police had arrived. After about ten compressions,
I could feel a faint heartbeat in my hands — at his neck, I could sense a pulse returning. Within ten minutes, he slowly regained consciousness. The police and others had gathered around by then.
As you know, in such cases — when someone is hit or found injured — they usually take everyone involved, especially if the person dies.
When the officers approached me, they asked, “Are you a doctor?” I said yes, and continued CPR. After around ten minutes, the man fully regained consciousness.
As he sat up in the ambulance, he asked me, “What happened to me?” He had no idea what had occurred. That was such a great miracle!
Every single month since the day I took the covenant here, something miraculous has happened on the 14th. The latest one occurred this September 14th.
I have so many things to share — about how Mother has appeared to me and worked miracles. After I came here in January, I used to buy a few dresses and some makeup items whenever I visited India,
but after that, I never bought a single dress or cosmetic again, even though I love beautiful clothes. I kept all that money aside for charity.
I have also been fasting every Friday since my childhood — since I was three years old, I have been praying on my knees, and even now I pray the rosary only while kneeling. That’s something I received from home,
and I continue to keep it faithfully as part of my devotion.
I began taking a three-day sacrifice fast. That means, for three days a week — though I leave for work in the morning and only return home around 11 at night — even if there’s a short break in the afternoon, I don’t rest or eat, I just manage to sleep a little.
After coming home, I pray before sleeping. Ever since visiting here and taking the covenant prayer, I’ve continued this practice faithfully — fasting three days a week,
eating only one meal a day, and setting aside all the money saved from that. Each month, I save about a thousand dirhams — sometimes more — and keep it entirely for holy purposes.
My approach has changed completely. Earlier, I used to help anyone who asked me for assistance. But now, even if no one asks, I go myself and give.
In our clinic, if someone comes and says they don’t have money, I treat them for free. If patients or their families are in need, I try to help them in whatever way possible.
If someone needs a ride to church, I wake up early and take them to Holy Mass. Then there’s another big miracle connected to the covenant. When I first came and took it,
you remember there were certain commitments we had to tick off — one was alcohol. I don’t drink, so that wasn’t an issue. The next was about the covenant papers. I thought, “Maybe I can’t give these out often, since I’m abroad.”
So I didn’t tick that one. I took four bundles of the papers and brought them with me. Later, I distributed a few among my clinic staff and kept the rest aside, thinking, “I’ll give them at church when I go.”
One day, a sister came to see me and said, “Doctor, my grandchild has been very sick with a terrible fever for many days — it’s just not reducing. Could you please take a look?”
I quickly remembered the Kreupasanam newsletters, which were still on my table. I took one, gave it to her, and said, “Keep this with you and pray with faith.” I also prescribed medicine —
not that I didn’t give medical treatment, but I prayed over it too. The next day around noon, that sister called me and said…
She said, “Doctor, my grandchild had been sick with fever for two weeks — but now, the fever is completely gone!” After that, within just fifteen days, all four bundles of the covenant papers I had brought were finished.
I have patients from around 40 different countries — Africans, Ethiopians, Mexicans, Argentinians, and many others. Whenever I give them a covenant paper, I always tell them: “If you’re just going to throw this away, please don’t take it. This paper is blessed — it’s from a holy place, given by a priest with prayer. Keep it reverently and pray.”
Most of them receive it with tears, saying “Mama Mary!” and praying devoutly. Within those fifteen days, I distributed every single paper. Then I realized — Mother Mary made me understand that this was something I was meant to do, and that I had made a mistake by not ticking that box earlier.
From that day until now, I always carry covenant papers in my bag. Even now, I have the last one with me, kept aside to give someone at the airport while traveling back. And till today, whenever I run out, someone from Kreupasanam brings me more to distribute.
Mother made me understand that this mission is my calling — not to sit idle, but to actively spread her message. Ever since, I have truly felt her walking beside me, guiding me in everything I do.
The Holy Mother who appeared here at Kreupasanam continues to bless me deeply. Father Joseph’s blessing during my last visit has been fulfilled in my life in ways I can’t describe.
I feel that if I fail to testify to these blessings, it would be a great wrong — both to our Blessed Mother and to this holy ministry.
Like wife mentioned earlier — on the 12th, Mother appeared, and on the 13th, we went to Kreupasanam. I’ve been running the Tata Motors dealership for Kozhikode and Wayanad for 16 years now,
employing 327 staff members, with a monthly turnover between 150 and 200 crores.
I’ve been in business for 16 years — at first, I was running everything alone.
Then, after some years, a competitor entered the market,
and gradually, the business started going into loss.
Month after month, the losses kept increasing — but I never told my wife anything. In addition to this business, I also have two medical centers and a pharmacy in Abu Dhabi, with around 60 staff working there. Yet, even by diverting funds from there, it became impossible to cover the mounting losses here.
When my wife told me, “You’re becoming too stressed,” I explained, “Right now, we’re facing a debt of ₹36 crores. If we shut down this dealership, 327 families who’ve worked with us for the past 16 years will lose their livelihood. The only way out seems to be transferring the dealership to someone else — that might help reduce our liability.”
“Then place this as a special petition before Mother Mary. Pray for her intervention — and next time, I’ll come with you to Kreupasanam.”
So we made that petition, and on January 17, I informed Tata Motors that I wished to exit the dealership. They said they had already awarded a new dealership to Gokulam Motors — but that business too was already facing losses.
I told Tata that I was no longer interested in continuing. “There isn’t enough market for three dealerships,” I said. “I’m already losing 30 to 35 lakhs every month.”
At that time, I had six showrooms and eight outlets across Wayanad and Kozhikode.
Tata officials called me and said, “Doctor, we understand your position. Yours is the largest showroom in South India — inaugurated personally by Ratan Tata in 2009. You’ve invested ₹150 crores just in infrastructure.”
They told me, “Normally we never transfer dealerships, but considering your long relationship with Tata and the challenges you’re facing, we’ll make an exception. We’ll negotiate with Gokulam Motors directly.”
They also said, “We know your two children are doctors — one settled in America, the other in Germany — and that you may not want to continue this line of business in your later years.”
So they suggested, “Doctor, I will talk to Gokulam, and we’ll support the negotiation.”
I agreed. Then, on April 2, my wife and I came to Kreupasanam and made the covenant again. That day, our total outstanding debt stood at ₹36 crores.
I showed all the bank documents to Father Joseph. He placed his hand on my head, prayed over me, and said, “Do not be afraid. Everything will turn out well. Go forward courageously”
After that, a meeting was scheduled for April 14 between Gokulam Motors, Tata Motors, and us.
During that discussion, we reached a general understanding. Then, on July 16, a final decision was made. I told them, “My only condition is that all my staff must be retained. I am willing to compromise on rent or other terms, but I cannot let my staff lose their jobs.” They agreed.
So, the final agreement was signed on July 16, and Gokulam Motors began operations on August 1. If the transfer hadn’t happened, I would have been left with a bank debt of ₹36 crores. But after this, the liability reduced to ₹21.5 crores, giving an effective profit of ₹14 crores. I still have to clear the remaining ₹21 crores.
Around that time, I had also invested in converting a piece of wetland into dry land to repay some debt. For three years, nothing had progressed. But within a week after taking the Kreupasanam covenant, the conversion was approved, and the final papers were issued — again, on the 14th of the month.
I have been a devotee of Mother Mary since childhood. When she appeared to my wife, I realized that her apparition in our car and the call to visit Kreupasanam were her way of protecting us from a great impending disaster.
Mother wanted us to become instruments of testimony, to pray, and to renew ourselves spiritually. That is why all these events happened — to teach us a lesson in renewal and preparedness.
From this, I learned that financial losses must be managed along with spiritual renewal. Mother and Jesus wanted me to understand this.
Before this, I used to drink socially and smoke, often with friends. After my wife’s experience and the covenant, I automatically stopped these habits without effort. I also stopped attending parties and worldly gatherings.
Earlier, I would give help only when people asked — for example, to flood victims, or to sisters for orphanages.
Now, I actively seek out those in need. If patients or people in orphanages require anything, I personally provide them with the necessary items, without waiting for them to ask.
We also do things like preparing food. In the area where we live, there are many workers who start early in the morning and work until evening. We cook food at home and provide it to them.
Doing such acts gives us immense joy. Until now, we were unable to do these things, but now we can. Similarly, once our debts and liabilities are fully cleared, I will definitely come here again to give my testimony.
I also pray every day for the thousands of patients, debtors, and students who are suffering and coming to the Marian Kreupasanam Center.
While praying like this, I experience what my wife saw — the scent of jasmine at my home, a sign that Mother Mary is with us. This gives me complete confidence; no matter how much debt we have, or whatever decisions I face, I carry the blessed salt and oil with me. Everything unfolds within the limits set by her grace.
Even with the bankers, I spoke yesterday, asking for some leniency. The property, worth ₹150 crores, has been pledged as collateral for this loan. Now I have to repay ₹21 crores gradually. They have agreed to help me clear it step by step.
After accomplishing so many things, we also pray for Father Joseph, the priests, and the nuns involved in Kreupasanam, asking God to bless them abundantly. We pray that those who are suffering may be relieved by the mercy of God and Mother Mary, and that this institution may continue to be blessed so it can serve others effectively.
As Father Joseph says, we were only praying but now we serve too. Another point I want to share — during my pre-degree studies, I began charismatic prayer. Since then, I have been reading the Bible regularly and practicing charismatic devotion.
Whenever I go, I spend most of my time in English meditation sessions. Over time, this develops into deep spiritual experiences. While the journey is gradual, the prayers continue, and after coming to Kreupasanam, I have been praying every day without fail.
We live our lives starting early in the morning, praying until evening. Whenever we find a little time, there is nothing else we can do — we can hardly listen to all of Father’s talks or testimonies.
This is the reality: day by day, our spirituality gradually increasing not decreasing at all. As someone who has actively participated in both aspects, I notice this difference clearly.
When we practice charismatic devotion, initially we come for daily meditation for a week, and its intensity is very high. Over time, the intensity naturally decreases, and we must return for the next session.
But here, it is growing stronger each day. May this happen for everyone. We pray for all, with immense gratitude, thanking Mother Mary and the Son of God.
Revelation 3:8, I know your works, Mother. Behold, I have established before you a door that no one can shut. Your power may be limited, yet you have kept my word and never denied my name.
Dr. Gracy Joseph and Dr. Joseph are living testimonies of the power of life, the Marian experiences, and the unique blessings of the Kreupasanam covenant. This presence — the presence of Mother Mary — is experienced in our lives.
When we experience Mother Mary’s presence, it signifies that she understands our life circumstances and sees everything. She asks us to remain more closely connected to her.
As Father Joseph says in the covenant, even things that seem impossible can be written down; great matters has to be written here.
Because if Mother appears in this small church in this little village, it is her way of speaking to the world: When you live with a pure heart, with simplicity, and glorify God’s name, your lives will be secured, and God will lift you up.
She also takes on your sufferings and restores prosperity, peace, and health in your families. This family is a testimony to that.
When you hold Mother Mary’s hands at this altar, life is always renewed. For every tearful issue in your life, there is a blessing of grace received from the Lord in her hands.
Therefore, we must embrace the covenant life with joy, be ready to let go, and allow life to flow. We are insignificant humans, and God is infinitely great. If we are willing to surrender our lives and problems into His hands, God will take our lives and use them.
This life will be one of blessings, anointing, and goodness for many — and this family’s testimony at this altar is proof of that.
We thank Mother Mary and the Lord for guiding this family from times of hardship to times of joy, for all the divine experiences and realizations received. With gratitude, we clap our hands and present this testimony.
